buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up

to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/GRC/South Eastern Railway A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 15% of total value. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 8. Generic

1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) Note: (1) The vehicle shall be made available for 24 hrsx7 days a week. Note: SUV Vehicle is required for; (i) SSE/S/C/KGP at Kharagpur which shall be utilized for his entire jurisdiction i.e. West Bengal, Odisha & Jh arkhand & out station for official work where-ever required. 1.The vehicle must commercially registered as per Motor Vehicle Act and have valid insurance certificate & Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate. The liability and risk of composite insurance covering vehicle thef t, damage, injury of passengers and public due to accident etc. are responsibility of the Contractor only. 2. Vehicle should not be older than 3 calendar years. At any point of time, vehicles should not be older tha n 5 years and the vehicle should be BS-VI or latest. 3. A name plate of suitable size is required to be made and fitted on the front of the vehicle. The name plat e should read "On Duty, Ministry of Railway, Govt. of India". 4 Vehicle colour should be white / white base colours. The vehicle should be mechanically sound and shall be well maintained with neat and clean interior/exteriors and hygienic. Three pairs of seat-covers and towe ls to be changed on alternate days. 5. Driver should be provided with white shirt and white pant. The cost of uniforms is to be borne by the co ntractor. 6. The driver must have the valid driving license, must possess good driving skill, obedient and courteous. Driver should not be suffering from hyperhidrosis or any other medical conditions resulting in foul body od our. Medical Certificate to this effect should be provided. The driver must be literate, having good knowled ge of roads, navigation skills and familiarities with traffic rules and regulations and should be able to comm unicate properly. He should also be able to do the day-to-day maintenance of the vehicle's cleanliness and functionality. Driver must have adequate control and patience and remain calm and composed even in str essful traffic situations and should never be a part of road rage or reckless driving. 7. All other terms and conditions of the contract for Hiring of Vehicles, which are not specified; Additional T erms and Conditions (ATC), will be governed by Service level Agreement (SLA) for monthly basis cab & tax i hiring services of GeM Portal. 8. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the Contract Period. The toll charges and other taxes for the outstation duty will be borne by the contractor. On production of toll receipt, the amou nt will be reimbursed by Railways. 9. In case of any break-down of the vehicle or in any other situation such as the firm fails to provide the all ocated category/model of vehicle, the firm must provide a higher category/model of vehicle as an alternati ve for stop-gap arrangement. 10. The tenderer shall submit their official address, Mobile / phone nos., e-mails, & Fax No. (if any) and the driver's mobile number for communication. 11. Driver should have a mobile phone with round the clock availability (24*7) to attend movement/progra m details of the vehicle. Service provider should bear the charges regarding Phone call/SMS communicatio n with the user. 12. Driver should not use mobile phone during driving in emergency situation; he should park the vehicle a nd talk/communicate with the permission of the occupant/passenger

13. The Railway in no case shall be responsible for any legal matters arising out of any State or Central Go vt. laws/ rules in the matters of employing the driver by vehicle's owner/Contractor. 14. The contractor shall bear the cost of repair or renewal of any kind of Railway properties if damaged by driver's negligence in rough driving, carelessness. In regard to assessment of such loss on account of dam ages, the decision of the Officer for whom vehicle is hired or his representative will be considered as final a nd binding on the Contractors. 15. Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss and damages to the vehicle and driv er. If any fine or penalty is imposed by various authorities such as Road Transport Officers/Authorities, Traf fic police etc for any voilation such as speed,traffic rules violation etc , the same will have to be borne by t he contractor only. 16. All hired vehicles should be equipped with prescribed emergency kit and a fire extinguisher as per stat utory provision. 17. No sub-contracting shall be allowed in any case. Vehicles should be in the name of the bidder and no s ubletting would be permitted. 18. The contractor shall submit the bill for the month or part thereof by 7th of the following month. The bill must accompany the certification of the officer/Secretary to PHODS/CHODS/AGM/DRM using the vehicles h aving day-wise use and kilometer of use and also furnish other documents such as Toll tax, Parking fees w hich need to be countersigned by the officer. 19. However, any penalty or fines etc. imposed by RTA, Police or other law enforcing agencies due to failur e/violation of traffic rules etc. are not payable to the contractor and such risk and cost will be borne by the contractor. 20. Other terms and condition will be as per GeM SLA, GEM GCC and other conditions shall be as per GeM updated from time to time.
